content_sections.heading: About UPSRLM Siddharthnagar
content_sections.text: The Uttar Pradesh State Rural Livelihood Mission works in Siddharthnagar through a district unit. That unit has a Block Mission Management Unit in each block and a District Mission Management Unit. These posts are in Model Cluster Level Federations, which are made up of women's self-help groups and village organisations (ग्राम संगठन). The Model CLF invites the applications, and the Office of the Deputy Commissioner (Self Employment), Siddharthnagar issued the notice.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be submitted only at the candidate's own home or related CLF, or at the Block Mission Management Unit. The last date is 5 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The number of posts may go down or up. Information on the Model CLFs and their vacant posts will come from the district and development block levels. The pay is not specified in the notice. The CLF Accountant must be a member of a women's group of the Uttar Pradesh State Rural Livelihood Mission. The candidate's group must be a member of a village organisation and a Cluster Level Federation. Age: 21-45 years. She must not be a defaulter of her group or of any bank. Qualification: at least 12th class pass. She must be able to read and write Hindi and have good knowledge of arithmetic. She must have a smartphone or Android phone and be skilled in using it. She must be willing to go to the bank branch during bank working hours and to travel to other villages. As needed, she must be willing to attend meetings of self-help groups, village organisations and the cluster federation, and to make field visits. She must also be willing to go on exposure visits and trainings inside and outside the state. Experience: at least 03 years of writing the books of the group, the village organisation and the Cluster Level Federation is compulsory. The CLF Accountant will be chosen from among experienced CLF Book Keepers. Under no circumstances will the CLF Accountant be allowed to work in her home CLF. The MIS Assistant must be a woman. Members of UPSRLM women's groups will get preference for this post. Qualification: at least 12th class pass. She must be able to read and write Hindi and have good knowledge of arithmetic. Age: 21-45 years. Experience and training: more than 30 days of work at the resource block and other places. This work must cover the concepts of forming and managing women's groups, village organisations and Cluster Level Federations, financial management, books of records and similar topics. She must not be a defaulter of her group or of any bank. She must have a smartphone or Android phone and be skilled in using it. She must be willing to travel to the villages linked to the CLF. As needed, she must be willing to attend meetings of self-help groups, village organisations and the cluster federation, and to make field visits. She must also be willing to go on exposure visits and trainings inside and outside the state. She must hold a certificate for a computer or software course of at least six months from an institution registered by the Government of India or a State Government. She must be able to use Microsoft Office and prepare reports on a computer. Under no circumstances will the CLF MIS Assistant be allowed to work in her home CLF. For the full eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both posts has a written examination and then an interview. The written examination is on 12 November 2026 and its result comes out on 13 November 2026. Interviews will be held from 13 November 2026 to 19 November 2026. The final result will be communicated at the Mission headquarters on 20 November 2026. For the Accountant post, the selection will be made from among experienced CLF Book Keepers. After the last date, each Block Development Officer will check the applications submitted at the CLFs in that block. Each officer must then send them, with a list, to the office of the Deputy Commissioner (Self Employment), Siddharthnagar by 4:00 PM on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UPSRLM Siddharthnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies: 10 Accountant and 10 MIS Assistant posts in Model Cluster Level Federations. The notice says the number of posts may go down or up.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UPSRLM Siddharthnagar Accountant and MIS Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for all posts is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Accountant and MIS Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Both posts need at least 12th class pass, the ability to read and write Hindi and good knowledge of arithmetic. The MIS Assistant also needs a computer or software course certificate of at least six months from an institution registered by the Government of India or a State Government.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for UPSRLM Siddharthnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For both the Accountant and the MIS Assistant post, the candidate's age should be 21-45 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that there is no fee for the application.

faq.question: Q6. Where do I submit the application?
faq.answer: Submit the application only at your own home or related CLF, or at the Block Mission Management Unit, by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process and when is the written exam?
faq.answer: Selection is by a written examination on 12 November 2026, with its result on 13 November 2026. Interviews follow from 13 November 2026 to 19 November 2026, and the final result will be communicated on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How much experience does the CLF Accountant need?
faq.answer: The Accountant must have at least 03 years of experience writing the books of the group, the village organisation and the Cluster Level Federation. She will be chosen from among experienced CLF Book Keepers.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply for the MIS Assistant post?
faq.answer: Only women can apply for the MIS Assistant post. Members of UPSRLM women's groups get preference. The candidate also needs more than 30 days of experience and training in group, village organisation and CLF management, plus the ability to use Microsoft Office.

faq.question: Q10. Can a selected candidate work in her home CLF?
faq.answer: No. Under no circumstances will the CLF Accountant or the CLF MIS Assistant be allowed to work in her home Cluster Level Federation.
